callouts.title: High quality aluminium
callouts.text: Handle made of high quality aluminium, with a 7 mm zinc-plated steel spindle.

callouts.title: Several locking positions
callouts.text: Locking positions at several degrees of the handle.

callouts.title: Key-locking version — CR603K
callouts.text: We also have the same handle with key lock for an extra of security. Fast and easy lock system.

callouts.title: Applications
callouts.text: Designed for European chamber aluminium carpentries, usable for right or left opening. Applicable on inward-opening hinged systems.

callouts.title: Features
callouts.text: Three possible distances between fixing axes: 84, 98 and 104 mm.

callouts.title: Applications
callouts.text: Handle for lift-and-slide doors. Its long grip makes opening and closing large, heavy sliding doors easier.

callouts.title: Features
callouts.text: Made of high quality aluminium, with a 10 mm zinc-plated steel spindle. Tested through 25,000 cycles with 400 kg doors.

callouts.title: Applications
callouts.text: Angled handle designed for in-line sliding doors with multi-point locking. Also compatible with tilt-and-turn systems using a spindle mechanism.

callouts.title: Features
callouts.text: Made of high quality aluminium, with a 7 mm zinc-plated steel spindle. Handle with 8 locking positions (every 45°). The handle's movement prevents accidents during the closing operation of some perimeter systems.

callouts.title: Applications
callouts.text: Spring-return handle set. Designed to be installed on aluminium hinged doors, with the option of adding a lock.

callouts.title: Features
callouts.text: Made of high quality aluminium, with an 8 mm zinc-plated spindle. Includes fixing screws. Rotating cap to hide the fixing screws.
